Text:
In Diamond (C), the MgV- center exhibits spin S = 1/2 with no zero-field splitting. The zero-phonon line is at 590.0 nm, and the radiative lifetime is 0.9 ns. The transition dipole moment is 1.7 Debye. At 300 K, T1 = 0.2 ms and T2 = 0.04 ms. The host dielectric constant is 5.7, bandgap 5.47 eV. Source: DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.124.183602.
